articles.title: Humanity's $36 million exploit tied to compromised laptop hosting a 'multisig' wallet
articles.snippet: The compromised laptop held enough multisig keys to take over the project's bridges on two chains, a basic security failure for a startup backed by Pantera and Jump Crypto.

articles.title: Forehead tattoos and alcohol dares: Inside the dark underbelly of crypto's memecoin craze
articles.snippet: Users are being paid to shave their heads, chug liquor and interview homeless people on camera, raising questions about whether Pump.fun's latest product rewards creativity or exploitation.

articles.title: Humanity Protocol token falls 85% amid $30M private key exploit
articles.snippet: The compromise of private keys belonging to a member of the Humanity Foundation has reportedly resulted in the theft of at least $30 million worth of its native token.

articles.title: White hats rescue $500K in NFTs after Flooring exploit
articles.snippet: CoinGecko and NFT Price Floor data show NFT market cap has cooled since April, while CryptoPunks and BAYC remain top collections by value.

articles.title: Bored Ape Maker Yuga Labs Rescues Dozens of Ethereum NFTs From Exploit
articles.snippet: The Bored Ape Yacht Club creator now holds more than 60 rescued NFTs in its custody as it works to return them to their rightful owners.
